description:
Bona ukusebenza ngokucacileyo.

Qalisa ngenkundla ofuna ukuyivavanya. I-LumaTrace izokuqondisa esinyathelweni esilandelayo kwaye igcine iimethrikhi angenakufumaneka njenge-N/A.

Windows: Khetha inkqubo yosetyenziso losetyenziso okanye umdlalo kule khompyutha, emva koko uqala uvavanyo. Ukuba inkqubo iphuma, uvavanyo kuyama okanye kurekhodwe ukuphazamiseka okucacileyo.

Android: Vula iinketho zomphuhlisi nokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB efowunini, ugunyazise le khompyutha, uvule usetyenziso ofuna ukuluvavanya, emva koko uchofoza Qalisa Uvavanyo. I-LumaTrace ithola ngokuzenzekelayo iphakheji elingaphambili.

Khetha isiphumo ukuze ujonge i-FPS, i-1% Low, ixesha besakhelo, i-CPU, imemori nemibiko ekhishiwe.

I-Android igcina i-ADB logcat ehlanziwe yesikhathi sovavanyo. I-Windows igcina iirekhodi eseshini ye-LumaTrace anezikhathi.

Amanani angekhoyo ahlala eyi-N/A kwaye awazaliswa ngo-0.

Akukho kulayisha efini
